# envoy

<!-- Generated by TestProjectDocsFresh (PRUFYX_UPDATE_DOCS=1 go test ./internal/communityapp -run TestProjectDocsFresh). Do not edit. -->

Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as
`--project envoy --help` on each route prints it. Identity, stage and rule
coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project envoy`. Shared flags, exit status and
the reference text of each route: [routes.md](routes.md).

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project envoy --envoy-bootstrap FILE --envoy-bootstrap-selected --from 1.34.14|1.35.13|1.36.10|1.37.6|1.38.4 --to 1.39.1 (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--envoy-bootstrap-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```

## prepare cncf

```text
prufyx prepare cncf --project envoy --envoy-bootstrap FILE --envoy-bootstrap-selected --from 1.34.14|1.35.13|1.36.10|1.37.6|1.38.4 --to 1.39.1 [--envoy-bootstrap-digest SHA256] [--format human|json|input]
```
